findings.job: ref_gate qfd_tile_nk_rp2_45_a2 (exact 4ecca5d9c gate, DPL-0033 at 3_5_place_dp); r3 8a47f4f41 gate running 00:47
findings.see: KNOWN pin-face glue squeeze, NOT FIXED in the newest image: the 47.5x432 um ot_qwen_tile_node macro sits 20.3 um off the W wall, and the 2,076 W-face pins (n_a/n_b/n_y/t_out, 514 each) must land their glue in that strip. 145 of the 170 located DPL-illegal cells are at x<50 um, y 200-500 um, i.e. in the W channel beside the node macro. Every other channel is also about 20 um wide (node->LSL 20.1, LSL col gaps 20.1/20.1, E gap 26.1). r3 (8a47f4f41) changes only the fences/regions; the macro x positions in the kit floorplan.json are unchanged (node x=22.464).
findings.fix: Give the W pin face a glue band of at least 40 um. Either move the node column right by about 20 um, which needs the outline widened 457.9->~478 um or the LSL columns repitched with their 20 um gaps kept and the 26 um E gap consumed, or put n_a/n_b/n_y/t_out on the node macro's own W edge as pass-through so the node pins abut the tile pins and no output flops sit in the channel. Changing only the fences (r3) cannot fix this: the failing cells already have nowhere to go in the 20.3 um strip.
findings.status_1016_0115: owner: r3 fence-only gate; if still illegal -> repitch macro columns for >=40 um W glue band (NK) / move NL tap glue into empty NE slot + widen ROM-top band.

findings.job: ref_gate qfd_tile_nl_rp2_45_a2 (exact 4ecca5d9c gate, DPL-0033); r3 gate running 00:47
findings.see: The NL tile has the same outline and LSL/ROM grid as NK but no node macro, so the W column (x 2-90 um, about 340 um tall) is empty while the cells that fail legalisation crowd elsewhere: 38 at x 350-400/y 500-600 (the channel under the right ROM stack and the empty NE slot, next to the 548 E-face tap pins), 23 in the 24.8 um band above the ROMs (y>800, N-face clock roots), and 16 at E x400/y400. The W pin squeeze is not the NL failure. The failures sit in the ROM-bottom/E-tap corner and the ROM-top band.
findings.fix: Use the empty W node slot: move the E tap glue / repair corridor into the vacant NE LSL slot (126x141 um), or swap the NE LSL with the vacant slot so the tap pins face open area. Widen the ROM-top band from 24.8 to about 40 um by moving the ROM stacks down into the NE slot area. Also reconsider sharing one 457.9x820.8 outline for NK and NL: NL leaves about 30k um2 empty.
findings.status_1016_0115: owner: r3 fence-only gate; if still illegal -> repitch macro columns for >=40 um W glue band (NK) / move NL tap glue into empty NE slot + widen ROM-top band.

findings.see: The 129.6x216 um gearbox carries 2,089 E-face pins (phy_rx/tx_frame, 1,043 each) on M4 alone, at 10 pins/um over 210 um. The E pin wall is a solid red column (bin density >1.0), and final congestion is red over the whole E half. W face: 1,199 pins at 6.7/um. GRT M2 49%, M3 33% overall, overflow 0. r13 is at CTS: max bin density down 1.077->1.005 and hot fraction 2.7%->0.5%, but the pin geometry is identical.
findings.fix: Split the E-face frame bus over M4+M6 (about 5 pins/um per layer), or lengthen the PHY-facing edge: rotate so the frame buses sit on the 216 um faces on two layers, or widen 129.6->~170 um to give the E pin-flop wall room. It closed, so this is a margin issue, not a blocker.

findings.job: newest pre-route gate qfd_d2d_static_r1-20261016-002934 (at CTS, 3_5_place_dp snapped); previous routes r1-r3-cb4ec1b91 EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION (GRT-0116), r1-r1-87cafef19 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD (-52 ps, clock detour, 481 um avg macro clock wire)
findings.see: All data pins are packed into the W half of a 475x281 um outline. N: 0-56 um and 180-295 um at about 10 pins/um on M5 alone (fdi/native/prog/rx buses 548-583 wide). S: 40-140 and 200-260 um at up to 10/um. W: 760 pins on M4. The E half (x>300) has no data pins and no cells, and 70% of density bins are empty. The single clock ck enters at the E-face midpoint (475, 145), about 300 um from the W-half sink mass (10.8k flops), which is why the r1 CTS detoured and left the S-face band 76 ps late. The new gate already widened the centre macro gap from 20.1 um (r3, congestion fail) to 40.8 um, which is fixed. The pin clustering and the clock entry are not fixed.
findings.fix: Spread the N/S fdi_tx/rx_flit and native/prog/rx buses over the full 475 um faces, or onto M5+M7 to halve per-layer density. Move the clock entry to the N-face centre near x 237 (sink centroid). If the E half must stay empty, shrink the outline 475->~330 um wide.

findings.job: qfd_xs_tap-xt6-b36b1cfd5 (CLOSED; native capture 502 ps FAIL) - newest; no successor after 15:50
findings.see: Calibration finding. The 216x216 um tile has 6,361 pins at 13% fill. The S face (aw bus, 553 pins) is packed into 26.5 um on M5, 20.9 pins/um, which makes a hot congestion block at bottom centre. Flops are pulled to the pin walls (N 9.2/um, E/W 10.4/um), and a long diagonal chain runs S->NE. Native capture 502 ps fails. GRT M2 40%, overflow 0.
findings.fix: Spread the S-face aw bus over the full 216 um on M5 (+M7), from 20.9 to about 2.6 pins/um. Place it opposite its N/E consumers, or re-face aw to the side its consumer sits on, to kill the S->NE diagonal. Fill is 13%, so shrinking is limited by the pin perimeter: 6,361 pins need about 640 um of 2-layer perimeter at 10/um.

findings.see: Six ROMs are stacked in a 194x551 um column and all 729 outputs exit the N face. They sit in two clusters (x 20-80 um and 140-180 um at about 9.6 pins/um on M5 alone) with 60 um of the N face unused, which makes red hot spots (density about 0.98) at the two N corners. The bottom ROM is about 450 um from the pins. The clock enters at the NW corner (30.9, 551) while the sinks span the full 551 um height. 80% of density bins are empty.
findings.fix: Spread crom_q/crom_addr evenly across the whole 194 um N face on M5+M7. Move clock entry to N-face centre or, better, put the clock and a pipeline-register row at the column mid-height. Alternatively rotate the tile so ROM outputs exit the 551 um long side toward the su_cbuf_g consumer.

findings.job: qfd_sp_band_lanes_q4_aau-dace0dae3-tc-hm0 (CLOSED TT +7.5/FF +0.3, block ot_qfd_band_lanes); odb released, ORFS images only. Newest full-tile attempts be5b56d78-*-ls2 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD (-33.5 ps, 21.5k endpoints), run dirs deleted
findings.see: Sixteen SRAMs in two tight columns sit at the centre of a 389x583 um outline. The centre channel between the columns is about 19 um and the row gaps about 16 um, and the centre channel and the row gaps glow red/orange in final congestion. Meanwhile the bands between the macros and the W/E pin faces (about 82-88 um each) are near-empty. Overflow is 0 and the tile closed with only +7.5 ps TT.
findings.fix: Pull the two macro columns apart. Use the 82-88 um side bands to widen the centre channel to about 40 um and the row gaps to about 25 um, or split into 4 columns with pins facing each consumer. Apply the same channel widths to the full-tile be5b56d78 variants that keep failing hold.

findings.see: Pin faces are fine: crom_q in on N, f_q out on S, both spread over the full 194 um at 3.7-3.9 pins/um. The clock enters at the extreme NW corner (0.1, 216), and the S-face output band (density up to 0.9) is the far end of the clock tree. The E third of the tile is empty, with 60% of bins under 0.05.
findings.fix: Move clock entry to the W-face mid-height or the N-face centre. Optionally shift the SRAM column left or shrink the width by about 40 um.

findings.see: Only 3,262 um2 of standard cells sit in a 345.6x216 um outline (14.8% fill incl. 2 SRAMs), and the E half is near-empty. The 576 scale_addr pins sit in three 20 um clusters on the W face (about 10 pins/um on M4), each with a green glue knot. The outline is the same as qfd_tt_core_leaf (deduped footprint).
findings.fix: If the scale leaf is instanced often, give it its own outline of about 200x216 um, or merge two scale leaves per core-leaf footprint. Spread the scale_addr groups evenly along the W face.

findings.job: qfd_tt_core_leaf-tc1-3ca5a5850 (ot-epyc4, daemon READY, 6_final present); tg1-4485b28e4 CLOSED TT +73.3/FF +7.4
findings.see: Pins are well spread (S mx_data 569 over 307 um at 1.9/um, E cmd 538 at 2.7/um, W 455 at 2.6/um), with no channels under 20 um, a clock at the E-face mid, and GRT M2 25%. The only issue is a low 19.8% fill: uniform thin placement (p90 0.17) over 345.6x216 um.
findings.fix: Optional: shrink to about 260x216 um, but the pin perimeter (1,779 pins) supports the current size at a comfortable density. Low priority.

findings.see: Actual PV column array (32 columns of 8 slices+join, 21.6 um gaps) is 1144.8x9309.6 um; the north home between ahub top (y=12675) and embgw/seq (y=21663) is only 8987.7 um tall, and the candidate box itself is 1080x8640. The north box also overlaps embgw, seq and 547 relay frames already placed in that channel.
findings.fix: Either drop the inter-slice gap 21.6->0 (gap=0 screen already shows worst matched-bit Manhattan 227 um vs 249 um): 16 x 518.4 = 8294 um tall, fits the 8988 um north slot with 690 um left over; or move seq+embgw north by >=330 um (host/d2d stack has room below ucie). Re-plan relay lanes rly_32/rly_1/rly_520/521 to run beside the PV column (x<4827 or x>5972), not through it. South half fits as is (10.3 mm clear).

findings.see: Two 128x256 SRAMs sit across the full 255 um width with a ~21 um channel between them; the 1025-bit rs bus enters on W at 8.6 pins/um M4-only, and both 512-bit row buses (t0 S, t1 N) are crowded onto the right half only, so the left SRAM pins route 120+ um along the macro edges. The congestion map shows red bands along both long macro edges and in the centre channel. The hold-ECO recovery has been stuck at 4 DRT shorts (M2 1, M3 2, M4 1) for 53+ iterations (from 12242 at iter 0).
findings.fix: Split the t0/t1 row buses into two 256-bit halves, each over its own SRAM (both halves of N and S), instead of the right half only; put rs on M4+M6 alternate (or split it to W 512 + S/N corners) so it is <=5 pins/um; widen the centre channel to >=30 um or abut the SRAMs (0 gap) and route through the outer channels. For the recovery: the 4 stuck shorts are a guide/keep-wire problem; rerun DRT with fresh guides in the 2 affected gcell tiles instead of more stubborn-tile iterations.

findings.see: Four 64x512 SRAMs in a 2x2 grid in a 475x281 um tile, ~20 um vertical centre channel. All 33 GRT overflow points sit inside x 224.6-249.7, y 70.7-102.6 um: the centre channel between the lower SRAM pair. M6 shows 0 routing resource, so the tile routes on M2-M5 only. Clock enters mid-E face; pins are scattered in short groups along N and S.
findings.fix: Open the centre channel to >=40 um (or move the SRAM pair to the outer edges with a 60 um central spine). Enable M6 for signal routing (resource is 0 now). Spread the N/S bus groups evenly. The die frame reserves 777.6x518.4 um, so the tile can grow from 475x281 to about 560x320 within its home.

findings.job: none (RTL only; abstract in die LEF)
findings.see: Every relay abstract puts all bits on M4 only, on W and E, packed at minimum M4 pitch (20.9 pins/um), whatever the face length. The wide ones fill their face: rly_2089 (61 inst) has 2089 pins over 100 of 105.8 um; rly_1025 (252 inst) and rly_1048 (82 inst) fill 49-50 um; rly_520/521/540/563 fill 25-27 of 30-32 um. That is 2.5x the 8 pins/um crowding limit, with no layer spread.
findings.fix: Size relays from the bit count at <=8 pins/um per layer: put the bus on M4+M6 (or M5+M7 for vertical runs) and make the face length about bits/16 um (rly_2089 -> ~130 um face on 2 layers; rly_1025/1048 -> ~65 um; rly_5xx -> ~35 um). Alternatively split rly_2089 into 2-4 narrower relays at the same stage. Gate a pre-route trial on rly_2089 and rly_1025 (largest x count) before the die run.

findings.see: About 4,100 pins on a 173x216 tile; E and W are M4-only at 8.7-8.9 pins/um. The NE quadrant (~25% of area) is empty while a red congestion cluster sits W-centre where the W emr/t_eq buses meet the S emr buses. The routed tile (4143 pins, N face 298) does not match the die abstract (3541 pins, no N face, W 1398, S 1042 at 9.8/um).
findings.fix: Re-pin from the die abstract (pin set and faces must match the die LEF; today they differ by 600 pins and a whole N face). Put the 4x520 emr buses on two layers (M4+M6 / M5+M7) at <=5 pins/um, and use the N face (now empty) for emr_EN/WN so the NE quadrant takes logic. Then the hot W-centre cluster spreads out.

findings.see: The W face carries 1171 pins on M4 only (8.2/um over 144 um). The E po/pi buses (617 pins) are packed into the middle 80 um of the E face at 7.7/um, and a dense red cluster forms just inside it. The top ~35% of the tile and the SE corner are empty (fill 0.24); the clock enters at N-centre-left.
findings.fix: Spread E po/pi over the full 173 um E face (span 0.46 -> 0.9) and the W ci/co/es/er buses onto M4+M6. Shrink the outline about 246x173 -> 200x150 (fill 0.24 -> ~0.35), keeping the ctrl column width 247.5 by stacking narrower tiles.

findings.see: In ahub_core, 1345 N pins (zh_sid/zh_we/zh_root, 1280 bits) fill the whole N face at 8.9/um, half of them on M3. The congestion map shows a solid red strip along N while the tile body is 56% empty (fill 0.185). Logic sits in two diagonal clusters linking the N bus to the E out_data and S si_data. The ahub parent route (q8) failed at hold with no layout kept, and the parent has never been hardened.
findings.fix: Move half of the zh buses (e.g. zh_we 512) to S or W, and use M5+M7 instead of M3 for face pins. Shrink the core 151 -> ~120 um square, or keep 151 and spread. Re-run the ahub parent with a kept 3_place odb so the hold failure can be inspected.

findings.see: The 162x104 tile has fill 0.60 and 4120 pins: N and S each carry ~1490 pins at 9.4/um (M3+M5), and W/E 512-bit wa/wb are at 8.3-9.1/um on M4 over about 60% of the face. Congestion is orange-red across nearly the whole tile, darkest bottom-centre and bottom-left. The clock enters at the NE corner.
findings.fix: Grow the outline to ~180x130 (fill ~0.45; the astk column is 220 um wide) and spread N/S buses on M5+M7. Move the clock entry to the centre of the N face.

findings.see: 336 of 375 pins are on E (M4, 3.9/um, two clusters in the middle 86 um), nothing faces N/S/W, and the clock enters at the NW corner, ~100 um from the pin face and sink centroid. Fill is 0.635 with 17% of bins over 0.85 and long vertical red streaks.
findings.fix: Move the clock entry to the E face centre (or tile centre via M8 bump) and lower util to <=0.55 (108x151 -> 120x160) or spread the E buses across the full 151 um.

findings.see: 4685 pins on a 172.8 square: ts0..ts3 1024 each on all four faces and the 512-bit y output also on E, so E carries 1540 M4 pins at 9.4/um. Pin-capture registers form red walls along N, S and E while the NW quadrant and SW/SE pockets are empty. GRT usage is 39% (M2 46%, M3 48%), the highest in this die; DRT iter 0 has 23,840 violations. No clock pin is recognised in the dump.
findings.fix: Move the 512-bit y output off E (to the NW/SW corners of W, or M6/M7 face pins) so E carries ts3 only (<=6.3/um). Spread the capture registers inward (pin-reg placement region 10-15 um deep instead of the edge row). If the PV gap goes to 0 (QKV-01), the bank-facing faces line up directly with slice pins.

findings.see: ECTL-C: E face carries 1059 M4 pins at 9.0/um; N/S row buses use only 60% of the face, and the tile is 61% empty (fill 0.186). ECTL-B gate: same two-SRAM layout as A but the row buses sit on the LEFT half of N/S, mirror of A (right half), so in the 648-um ectl parent the A->B->C row columns do not line up.
findings.fix: Align the t0/t1 row pins of A, B and C to the same x columns (or spread all three over the full width) so the parent N/S faces pass straight through. Put the C si/so (634+425) bus on M4+M6. Shrink C to ~110x130.

findings.see: Minor items. land_emb_ifw (173x65, fill 0.61): one hot window at W-centre. pv_ctl (43 um square): 68 S pins packed in 6.4 um (10.6/um) and 15% of bins hot. host_ctl: 744-bit tk bus on W at 9.2/um, fill 0.12 (78% empty). cdc_wleaf and seq_xs_tp8 are clean (<=4 pins/um, no hot windows).
findings.fix: pv_ctl: spread the S epoch/out_age buses over the full 43 um face. host_ctl: shrink 65x108 -> ~50x80 and put tk on M4+M6. land_emb_ifw: widen to ~190 um or lower util to 0.5.

findings.see: No odb survives (EARLY_FAIL_HOLD, deleted); 4_1_cts log: four independent CTS roots ck (4,853 sinks), ck_ingest[0] (9,279), ck_ingest[1] (9,293), ckv (118). Hold repair cannot converge: 23,633 hold violators, WS -100 ps, 44,160 hold buffers inserted in the first 1 h chunk, still 22,965 violators.
findings.fix: Do not let CTS build the ingest roots and ck as separate unbalanced trees: either one root (ck) with ck_ingest as generated/derived clocks balanced to it (common-root CTS, or set_clock_latency/skew-group the four roots to one insertion target), or put a retiming register stage at every ck_ingest->ck crossing so hold is local. Re-submit only after a pre-route gate shows the same-root insertion.

findings.see: Successor c9 refused at floorplan (FLOORPLAN_MARGIN), no odb left: std-cell 20,396 um2 in a 30,905 um2 core = 66% util (rule <=60%).
findings.fix: Grow outline to ~36,000-37,000 um2 (55-57% util), e.g. +10% on the face that does not carry the stage bus, and re-gate; c8 is still RTL-only so c9 is the live route.

findings.see: 100x199 um tile at 63% fill. W (c0) and E (c1) buses of 776 pins each are squeezed onto M4 in the middle 74.5 um of a 199 um face (10.4 pins/um); N xb bus 1,024 pins on M5 at 10.4 pins/um over the full 100 um. A red density band (density >1.0) fills the top ~20% under the N wall, plus a second hot band at the S wall. Clock enters at the S face, x=24 um (SW corner area), far from the N-wall flops. GRT overflow 0, but FF -7.86 ps after route, now in hold ECO.
findings.fix: Spread c0/c1 over the full 199 um W/E faces (M4+M6 or M4 with 2x pitch) to drop them to ~4 pins/um; split the 1,024-bit N xb bus over M5+M3 or move half to W/E, or widen the tile to ~140 um (fill ~0.45) so the N pin-wall flops have room; move the clock pin to the centre of the S face (x~50) or the tile centre.

findings.see: s81_static_vm_boundary (collective|VM seam leaf) is a pin-to-pin wall: W 2,234 and E 2,146 pins on M4 (9.4-9.8 pins/um), S 1,651 on M3+M5 (11.6/um). All cells sit in 1-2 bin columns against the W/E walls and the S edge; the centre is 74% empty. A diagonal staircase of cells and a hot congestion knot at the SW corner show a bus that enters at S-left and fans across to the E face mid-height (long internal chain).
findings.fix: Order the W and E pins so bit i sits at the same y on both faces and the S bus lands under its E/W destination (removes the diagonal); then shrink width 151->~60 um (fill ~0.35) or merge into the collective parent as a channel. Spread S over full 151 um on M3/M5 at <=8 pins/um.

findings.see: 576.7 x 25.9 um strip, fill 0.064: N and S buses (1,135 pins each, M5) sit only in x=227-341 um (span_frac 0.20, 10 pins/um); all logic is a red block (density >1) under that 113 um window; the other 80% of the strip is empty (88% empty bins).
findings.fix: Either spread N/S buses across the full 576 um, as the ctfn/ctfs siblings do (5.1-5.6 pins/um, span 1.0), or shrink the outline to ~140 x 26 um around the window and let the HC row put the gap to other use.

findings.see: Same 576.7x25.9 strip, fill 0.134: pins span x=40-341 um (span_frac 0.52); logic forms two islands, a red block at x=230-340 and a smaller one at x=40-90. The E 40% of the strip is empty (76% empty bins). SS sensitivity is -184 ps against +144..+243 for siblings.
findings.fix: Spread both islands' buses over the full width so the logic distributes like ctfn/ctfs, or cut the strip to ~350 um.

findings.master: dsfd_sp_hc_c / dsfd_sp_hc_t (HC kits ctfn_nt / ctfs_nt / ctfnq*)
findings.see: Pins spread well (5.1-5.6 pins/um, span 1.0), but in a 25.9 um-tall strip every flop is pulled to the N pin wall: a continuous red row (density >1.1, p90 1.12-1.14) along N, a thin green row at S, and an empty centre. A congestion hot box at x~40-70 um in ctfs (local logic island).
findings.fix: Raise strip height 25.9->~35 um, or put alternate N bits on M3 to split the N-wall flop row into two rows; closed with large margin, so do it only if the HC row has height to spare.

findings.see: 86x130 um, fill 0.40, GRT overflow 0 (M2/M3 58% used). i_sel (672 pins) is a single M4 wall on W at 5.6 pins/um, and its flops form a red column against W; i_data (212) makes a red row at S. The E strip (~10 um) and SE corner are empty. Clock at W mid-face (r3c 'ckmid'). r2 predecessor missed hold at FF -28.7 ps; the hold risk is pin-wall flops close to the W clock entry.
findings.fix: Split i_sel over W M4 + N/S M5 (or move half to E, which carries only 102 pins) so the flop wall is not one column; move the clock entry toward the tile centroid (N or S face centre) rather than the W wall the flops sit on.

findings.see: 194x130 um, fill 0.187: all logic is one blob in the middle 2/3; the W and E thirds are empty (43% empty bins). W/E faces carry 4 and 6 pins. ids (672) on N and src_bank (424) on S are well spread (2.6-4.1 pins/um).
findings.fix: Shrink width 194->~130 um (fill ~0.28) keeping the N/S pin pitch at <=6 pins/um; this returns ~8,000 um2 per instance x4 to the VM hub.

findings.master: s81_a2f_field16 / s81_a2f_meta26 (VM a2f, superseded by field4/control4)
findings.see: field16 183.6x140.4: GRT overflow markers saturate the whole tile at 20,000 (cap); this is global wire demand, not a pin hotspot. meta26 259x162 at 55% util stalls the same way (markers 20000 flat over 20 iterations).
findings.fix: Already structurally handled by the 4-way field4/control4 split (field4 r3c GRT overflow 0). Do not re-submit field16/meta26; delete the run data per the failed-job rule.

findings.see: 130x86 um, fill 0.048, 91% empty bins: logic is three islands (W-mid, NW, E-edge) tied to the W/E pins (98 each, 27% span) and to an N bus of 96 pins packed in 11 um (8.7 pins/um, span 0.09).
findings.fix: Shrink to ~45x45 um (fill ~0.3), or spread the N bus over >=40 um and align the W/E groups so the islands merge.

findings.see: 123x248 um, fill 0.139, 59% empty: N (624) and S (622) M5 buses, logic is a central blob; the N/S bands and W/E margins are empty.
findings.fix: Shrink height 248->~140 um (fill ~0.25); N/S pin pitch is unaffected.

findings.see: Input bus i is on the E face and output o on the W face, but at die level every driver (sstn xa/xb) sits WEST of the relay, so all 1521+1521 input bundles wrap around the tile. Inside the tile the flops cluster at the E (input) face and the launch path to the W output runs the full 24 um width plus a detour under the core.

numbers.die_input_bundles_facing_away: 1521/1521 each (100%), driver up to 205 um behind the E face
numbers.die_output_facing_away: 896/4329 (21%), o on W but qbank_S.i_x0/x1 229-243 um EAST

findings.fix: Make the input face W and the output face E (WE), toward the actual drivers and loads. Fix the generator so it picks faces from the driver/load PIN positions, not from instance centres (tools/dsrom_s81_fulldie.py ~L4416-4426 and ~L4622-4630: fi/fo = fc(centre of driver/load INSTANCE), and "if fo == fi: fo = opposite" forces a fold). Put the single register column at mid-tile (or split the in/out flops toward their faces) so launch and capture each cross about 12 um. 266_EW folds into 283_EW (planned dedupe), so one fix covers 3042 instances.

findings.job: s81-dsfd-cfifo-colck-a6ca75fbe-tt (latest 4 all NEEDS_RTL; last CLOSED s81-dsfd-cfifo-290446310 on retired ot-epyc2)
findings.see: No routed odb exists, so there is no tile image. The die binds an elements.lef cfifo view (432x95 um) whose pins are cc,ck,co,cr,rd,rf,ri,rs,rst,st,x2,xa,xb,xd,xf. Die.v connects xd2 and xf2 on all 128 instances, and the view has no pins for them.

numbers.fail_detail: cfifo.x2 -> sstn_*sinf_x2.x2i: jog 25.7 um in a 9.0 um channel, cut 0.95 > 0.6

findings.fix: Close a cfifo with the xd2/xf2 ports (v2 RTL) and rebind it. Until then 68,864 die bits connect to nothing, which breaks the no-stub/port-bind rule. Place x2 directly under the sinf station x2i column (zero jog), or widen the 9 um channel to at least 26 um.

findings.see: Both 63-bit inputs a and b sit in 7 um at mid-W. The logic blob spreads from there to S-left. The clock enters at mid-E, 40+ um from the logic, and the E third of the tile is empty. At die level the drivers (rly_63_NS/WS outputs) are EAST of the node, so the W-face inputs face away.
findings.fix: Move a/b to the E face (toward the relays) and spread them over at least 30 um on M4 at 2-track pitch. Put the clock entry at the logic centroid (S face near x=35%). Shrink the outline from 86 to about 55 um wide. Apply to LLfu (canonical) so LLfd/LLd rebinds inherit it.

findings.see: The tile is 17.3x41 um. q0..q6 (336 b) and a sit on W at 9.75 pins/um, cfg/go on N, and the clock at S centre. The worst path is a combinational W-in -> N-out feed-through. At die level the N-face cfg bus lands 152 um off qbank_S.i_cfg across a 4 um gap, the mirrored row is bit-reversed, and every ROM rd->q bundle is interleaved.

numbers.die_lc_input_facing_away: 119/17082; lc fed by rly_15_* outputs that face away (see S81F-07)

findings.fix: Register the 20 feed-through pins. Place cfg/go_e pins at the x of qbank_S.i_cfg, or co-place cfg7_seq centred under its qbank, so the jog is ~0. Give the mirrored row a mirrored-order variant or a centre-symmetric pin order. Order q0..q6 pins to match the ROM rd bit order. Put the clock entry at the W-face centroid of the q capture flops.

findings.see: The 60.5x25.9 um tile has 604 pins on each of N and S, across 93% of the face on M3+M5. The cells pack into the S (input) half and the N half is nearly empty, so every output has to climb 13 um. The clock enters at mid-W, at one end of a 60 um wide tile. At die level, 896 of the 1898 instances (mirrored row) get i_x0/i_x1/i_cfg bit-reversed, and 896 input bundles from rly_283/266 U-turn.
findings.fix: Put the clock entry at the S-face centre (sink centroid). Spread placement over the full height or cut the height to about 18 um. Provide a mirror-order variant, or the die must not mirror qbank_S rows. The S81F-01 face fix removes the U-turns.

findings.see: Die-level pin geometry only (no route). The sstn x2 -> 536_SN.i bus is straight but jogs 52-74 um inside a 6-10 um channel: pin-align FAIL, and the jog wires spill onto the over-tile tracks. 536_SN.o is on N while 354 of its loads (sstn x2i) are 70 um SOUTH.
findings.fix: Align the 536_SN i pin window with the sstn x2 pin window (same x span), or move the relay so the jog is under 20 um. Open the station-relay channel to at least 36 um. Recompute the 536_SN/SW faces from pin positions (generator fix in S81F-01).

findings.see: The 15-bit relays that feed ot_s81_cfg7_seq.lc have outputs facing away from the load. The 15_NS input faces away from the sstn cc driver, which sits 338 um behind it. The tile is 17.3x17.3 um at 5.6% fill, and the 15 pins sit in 1.3 um.
findings.fix: Re-derive faces from pin positions (generator fix in S81F-01). Merge the 15-bit cc/lc chain into the adjacent 63/66-bit relay tiles, or use a ~6x6 um tile.

findings.master: small relay members with 100% facing-away: dsfd_rly_63_EW (44), 63_SN (62), 66_WE (26), 66_NE (5), 63_ES (131 in), 2_EW (47/67)
findings.see: The output faces the opposite way from the load (63_EW o on W, load 697 um EAST; 63_SN o on N, node_LLfd.b 140 um south; 66_WE o on E, cfifo.ri 100 um west). 63_ES has i on E while all 131 drivers (rly_63_WE.o) are west. This is the same generator root cause as S81F-01, including the forced fold when driver and load are on the same side.
findings.fix: Same generator fix as S81F-01. For a same-side driver and load, emit an L or U variant with both pins on that face instead of forcing the opposite face.

findings.see: The tile is 157.7 um square. Ten 70-bit inputs (di0-9) sit on N, di10 alone on S, and the 761-bit output on W. The clock enters at the SW corner. Logic hugs the W and N faces, and the SE ~35% is empty, so capture flops at the N-E corner are about 200 um from the clock entry.

numbers.die: stnh_70x4.do -> di4/6/8/9: 4 U-turn bundles (E face vs N face)

findings.fix: Move the clock entry to the NW corner or N-face centre (sink centroid). Move di10 to N with di0-9. Shrink to about 158x100 um. Do this on the hr_W1 canonical.

findings.see: The 70-bit di/do buses are packed into 3.5 um of a 17.3 um face, which uses every M4 track. Native timing passes, but the die router must fan out 70 wires from a 3.5 um window at 3,855 instances. 10-12% of die bundles face away (do0 E vs di0 W chains).
findings.fix: Spread di/do over at least 7 um at 2-track pitch (or M4+M6), aligned to the same y window on both faces. Planned rebind to 86x1: apply it there.

findings.see: The station is 172.8x30.2 um at 10.7% fill. 566-574 pins per face on M5 only cover 50-62% of the face. xa/xb leave on N, but the rly_283/266 inputs they feed are to the EAST (20% of bundles U-turn on the station side).
findings.fix: Put pins on M3+M5 (as qbank does) and halve the width to about 90 um. Put xa/xb on the face toward the relays. With the S81F-01 fix (relay i on W) the corner becomes straight.

findings.see: GRT finished congested (odb not kept). All 8 overflow gcells sit in one row at y=27.9-29.1 um on a 12.96x34.56 um tile, at the N output face. The source nets are dq bits plus ot_outhold hold-pad buffers bunched at the output pins.
findings.fix: Spread dq over the full N face on M3+M5, or move the hold padding off the output face (input side or mid-tile). Widen the tile to about 20 um if needed.

findings.see: The tile is 75.6x92.9 um at 0.60 fill, with 5668 registers for 515 bits on two clocks. Congestion is uniformly orange (M2 52%) with no overflow. The clock enters at S x=27%. At die level, o -> bk_collector_c1 jogs 82 um inside a 6.3 um gap (pin-align FAIL, cut 2.58), and both m2l inputs U-turn (W vs W).
findings.fix: Re-audit native timing on the n4refclk view (the 356 ps capture predates it). Align the o pin window with the bk_collector_c1 cSW window, or open the gap to at least 36 um. Put i on the face toward the m2l hix/hco drivers.

findings.see: The faces match the chain for 96-98% of bundles. The 63-bit i/o buses sit in 6.0 um of a 15.1 um face (2-track pitch). The i and o windows are offset by about 4.5 um (WE: in at y 45-85%, out at y 15-55%), so a straight chain jogs at every hop. 63_NE.o -> 63_WS.i has 16 pin-align FAILs (jog 119 um in a 3.1 um gap).

numbers.native: 1-pin fails <= 224 ps (WE capture 198.9, WS launch 220.6, WN launch 223.7, SE capture 217.0)

findings.fix: Put i and o in the same window (centre the band) so straight hops have zero jog, and spread to about 12 um. Fix the 63_NE -> 63_WS placement (3.1 um gap) or open it to at least 36 um.

findings.master: narrow-bus relays/stations: dsfd_rly_2_* (5890 inst), rly_1_* (903), rly_15_* (1573), hstnh/hstnv_<=20 (~600)
findings.see: Tiles of 1-20 bits use the 15.1-17.3 um minimum outline: rly_2_NE at 1.1% fill, hstnh_2/hstnv_2 at 0.8%, rly_15 at 5.6%. Each is almost entirely empty power grid.
findings.fix: Fold the 1/2/15-bit control relays into the wide relay or station tiles they travel beside (one tile, several buses), or allow a ~6x6 um minimum tile. Most hstn small members are already marked REBIND to _20.

findings.master: DIE r2b2 (GRT running E4) / r2f2 plan
findings.see: Centre column between the two NK tile arrays (x 12.52-20.20 mm) is 7.68 mm wide but only 45% covered; south strips left/right of the IO row are completely empty. Port-tile buses cross the empty centre to the far edges of both arrays (r2f2 plan buses all red, 6+ stage reach).
findings.fix: Narrow the centre column to its content (~4.5 mm: SFU 3.24 mm + one port column): pull the east NK array west by ~3 mm; split the six port tiles 3 west / 3 east so each array's port column sits on its own inner edge (today all six sit west of SFU so the east array is fed across the whole centre); spread the three SerDes PHYs along the south shoreline under the arrays (or lower the arrays into the empty south strips) instead of a centre IO block with two empty 10 mm wings. Expected: die ~-15% area or the same area with ~3 mm shorter port->array buses.
findings.status_1016_0115: owner reply: port 3W/3E split measured earlier r1 cut 1.096 FAIL (port<->f1 6.3 kb > 4.1 kb saved); 4.87 mm VM blocks a 4.5 mm centre; PHYs must stay on an edge. Owner pricing (a) die height -1.6 mm with centred 2-row IO shoreline block, (b) port-stack trim / centre narrowed to content. New homes r2h: centre 7.88 mm, cut 0.592.

findings.see: One field reset net drives 1,585 terminals across the whole die from rstseq_rom at (13.7, 7.6) mm (GRT-0281 large fanout 1585); the bus picture shows it as the fan from the west-edge xcol h_0 because qfd_xcol_w's LEF declares rst_n[0] DIRECTION INOUT. Clock nets n_clk_r* have 1,135-1,289 terminals each (CTS, fine).
findings.fix: Registered reset tree for n_rst_field (<=500 um hops, one sync flop per tile row / station group, as the r9 die rule says) instead of one 39 mm, 1,585-sink net (with OT_ROUTE_RESET=1 GRT routes it as a plain signal net; otherwise it is left to nobody); fix the xcol_w/xcol_e abstract so rst_n is INPUT. Note r2b2 GRT has sat on extra iteration 3/12 for >80 min (M4/M5 derated 30%).
findings.status_1016_0115: owner reply: r2b2/C23s were RELAY-SKIP diagnostics (skip the registered reset tree); r2h1/r2h2 FULL relay generations include it; owner will check rst_field fan-out/reset_over_500 and fix xcol rst_n INOUT.

findings.see: Central spine is almost empty in both halves (only relays) and the NW/NE corners above the arrays are empty; the owner's pvw0/pvw1 split-PV candidate (2 x 1080x8640) uses exactly this space - correct direction. South spine clear width at y=5 mm is only 1,287 um (north 1,567 um), so 1080 + 2 x 259.2 um channels (1,598 um) does not fit south.
findings.fix: Adopt the N/S PV split flanking AHUB; widen the south spine to >=1,600 um by shifting the two south lane arrays outward ~160 um each (the north arrays already sit there), and re-plan the 525 spine relays (qkd_rly_32/_t1/_1/_17 chains) into the 259 um side channels before GEN.

findings.see: Four parents are planned as hair-thin full-height strips: astk 220 x 9,675 um (aspect 44:1), land 173 x 12,141 um (70:1). astk->ectl_c links reach 9.06 mm; the bus picture shows every lane fanning to the strip centre. These are still RTL-only parents (13/14 leaves closed).
findings.fix: Do not harden a 9.7/12.1 mm strip as one parent: cut each strip into per-head-group segments (8 x ~1.2 mm) hardened once and replicated, each beside the lanes it serves, with a registered spine between segments; one clock entry per segment.

findings.see: The hub band between the field columns (x ~10-22 mm) is half white: large empty areas west of SU_S, between SU_S and HC, and around BK_SELECTOR. HC_T sits ~10 mm south of VM and its bus to VM is one long red (6+ stage) run; SU_S is fed by a long red diagonal from the gather/capture node; BK_COLLECTOR (top) and BK_SELECTOR (bottom) are ~22 mm apart.

findings.fix: Compact the hub around VM: HC_S/HC_T as an east tower directly against VM's east face, SU_S directly under VM, BK_COLLECTOR/BK_SELECTOR adjacent; then either return ~2-3 field columns' worth of area (~60-90 mm2) to fields or shrink the die width. Generous hub room (owner 10-15) is still met with <25% white instead of 51%.

findings.master: DIE c21h (inherited, GRT running E4, iter 9/12) - column reset/clock nets
findings.see: Every field column shows a red fan from its qbank row: n_rs_col_<c> (451 terminals) and n_ck_col_<c> (584) are single nets per column. In the dump 29,861 qbank_N->relay and 14,058 qbank_N->ROM links exceed 600 um (max 4.1 mm / 6.6 mm). dsfd_qbank_N's LEF declares ck[0]/rs[0] DIRECTION INOUT. Relay-relay hops are healthy (p50 197 um, p99 456 um, none >1 mm).
findings.fix: Registered per-column reset tree (one sync stage per ~500 um / per qbank row) instead of one 451-sink net; write qbank_N ck/rs as INPUT in the abstract. Column clocks stay with CTS but check insertion against the 300 ps rule per column root.
